patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in crm, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose Mailchimp only if your buying job matches “Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing).” rather than Oracle Siebel CRM's shape. Choose Oracle Siebel CRM only if your buying job matches “Oracle Siebel CRM legacy enterprise platform; custom quote only.” rather than Mailchimp's shape. Workflow advantage: Mailchimp leans lead-management, inbound-sales; Oracle Siebel CRM leans pipeline-management, sales-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in crm, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Mailchimp is Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing).; Oracle Siebel CRM is Oracle Siebel CRM legacy enterprise platform; custom quote only..
- Company-size focus: Mailchimp (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Oracle Siebel CRM (enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Mailchimp-leaning lead-management, inbound-sales, high-volume-lead-management vs Oracle Siebel CRM-leaning pipeline-management, sales-automation, account-management.
- Researched limits: Mailchimp — Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform; Oracle Siebel CRM — Legacy enterprise platform — high TCO and specialization.

Limitations — Mailchimp: Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform; Paid pricing is contact-based and changes — verify live; Oracle Siebel CRM: Legacy enterprise platform — high TCO and specialization; Custom quote only.

Poor-fit cases: Mailchimp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform · Oracle Siebel CRM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Legacy enterprise platform — high TCO and specialization · Avoid Mailchimp if you actually need Oracle Siebel CRM's motion (Oracle Siebel CRM legacy enterprise platform; custom quote only.)
